note: Router table (docs/spec-intent-routing.md). First matching row wins. A row picks a protocol; it never contains clinical steps. Routing rules are team values, not clinical guidance.

spo2_low.source: team value (placeholder, not clinically reviewed; Spec 1 to cite a bound)

rows.reason: The automatic arrest rule fired, so the questions are skipped.
Rescuer reports the patient does not respond and is not breathing normally.
The live heart rhythm is an arrest rhythm.
Oxygen saturation is below the bound, or the rescuer reports the patient is not breathing.
Rescuer reports chest pain in a patient who responds (crew-reported symptom).
Rescuer reports a cabin air problem.
A cabin air alert is active.

fallback.reason: No cited protocol matches what was reported. Ground should advise.
